name: Open WDM-PCM (A1+G1+B3)
thermal_control_elements: PCM micro-heaters + ring tuning + package TEC/spreader; OMCC thermal scheduling
notes: Most practical/open path (A1+G1+B3, passive dielectrics + ref A1). Thermal for PCM writes and ring stabilization dominate; 2.5D integration feasible.

name: Thin-film membrane stack (EO-tuned)
thermal_control_elements: Electrode/RF routing thermal load managed by spreading; package stabilization
notes: High speed/BW via EO-tuned membranes; volatile/low NV capacity, EO platform dependence and driver/RF thermal load need management.

name: Thin-film membrane stack (PCM+EO hybrid)
thermal_control_elements: Localized micro-heaters for PCM layers, isolation trenches, spreading; EO thermal budget
notes: Balanced NV+fast trim (PCM+EO). Localized PCM write heat (300C) with EO co-integration is the main constraint; good memory density.

name: Membrane-Brush NV (A1+G3+3D)
thermal_control_elements: Segmented heaters per voxel, vertical/lateral isolation, integrated heat spreader/manifold; strict sequencing
notes: High NV volumetric capacity (3D brush). Feasibility gated by 3D alignment/yield and heat extraction (segmented heaters, spreader/manifold, sequencing).

name: Volumetric Tensor Membrane (G2/G3+F2+A1)
thermal_control_elements: Distributed heaters/EO drivers, high-capacity heat spreading/cooling, active stabilization
notes: Max capacity/throughput potential (tensor volumetric). Highest integration/thermal/alignment burden and FTO sensitivity; requires aggressive 3D packaging/cooling.
